events.details: Independent specialist broadband ISP established January 2004 by Lorraine Rose, based in Capalaba, Brisbane QLD. Earliest Wayback capture of aanet.com.au is 9 Apr 2004, consistent with a Jan-2004 launch (no evidence for the previously listed 1996 origin).

Acquired by Perth-based Eftel (agreed Jan 2006, completed mid-2006), doubling Eftel's broadband base to ~40,000; carried on as an Eftel brand. Eftel was itself acquired by M2 Group (now Vocus) in 2013.
source: Sydney Morning Herald, 14 Jul 2006: 'EFTel has doubled its broadband customer base ... with the purchase of privately held rival aaNet'
Eftel acquired by M2 Group in 2013: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eftel
